snippet.title: Talk of the Tavern | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Enter the tavern and build your mercenary guild in Talk of the Tavern, a competitive co-op pixel-art autobattler roguelike.

Travel toward the King’s castle, stop at taverns along the road, outbid rival guilds for powerful mercenaries, and shape your team with game-changing Scrolls.

Survive the journey and prove your guild is worthy of the King’s Tournament.

Wishlist on Steam and join the Discord to follow development!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4994640/Talk_Of_The_Tavern/
https://discord.gg/b7jmhvYsvg
